headline: Foreign media write extensively about Orlen. Tusk: 'Shame across the whole world'
summary: A Financial Times article on the circumstances behind Polish refiner Orlen's PLN 1.6 billion loss prompted a sharp reaction from Prime Minister Donald Tusk. The article also referenced Venezuelan oil and unclear transactions.
why: Orlen is Poland's largest listed oil refiner and fuel retailer, state-controlled, so governance and losses at the company draw investor attention.

impacts.name: Orlen
impacts.why: The reported PLN 1.6 billion loss and questions over transactions bear on the company's financial standing and governance.
